About.label: Our Story
About.title: Where Flowers Become Memories
About.intro: Decore is a luxury flower studio and event decoration house based in Ethiopia. We craft arrangements and full venue experiences for weddings, celebrations, and the quiet moments that matter most.
About.beautyText: Every stem is chosen with intention. We design for impact and emotion.
About.loveText: From proposals to anniversaries, we help you say what words cannot.
About.celebrationText: Weddings, graduations, cultural ceremonies — we elevate every occasion.
About.luxuryText: Premium materials, refined styling, and service that feels personal.
About.rootedText: We understand Habesha ceremonies, local venues, and the colors and flowers that feel like home. Delivery across Addis Ababa and major cities, with Telebirr and bank transfer ready when you need them.

FAQ.label: Help
FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Quick answers about orders, delivery, and decorations
FAQ.stillHint: We're happy to help by phone, WhatsApp, or email.
FAQ.q1: Which cities do you deliver to?
FAQ.a1: We deliver across Addis Ababa and major cities including Bahir Dar, Gondar, Hawassa, Mekelle, Dire Dawa, Adama, and more. Delivery fees vary by location; Addis Ababa orders over 3,000 ETB often qualify for free delivery.
FAQ.q2: How far in advance should I book event decorations?
FAQ.a2: For weddings and large events we recommend booking at least 2–4 weeks ahead. Smaller arrangements can often be arranged with a few days' notice, depending on the season and flower availability.
FAQ.q3: Can I customize a design from the gallery?
FAQ.a3: Yes. Use “Customize Similar” on any design page, or our Custom Design builder to choose occasion, flowers, colors, size, and add-ons. We’ll confirm details and pricing with you.
FAQ.q4: What payment methods do you accept?
FAQ.a4: Cash on delivery and bank transfer are available now. Telebirr and CBE Birr can be enabled by the business. We’ll confirm payment details when your order is accepted.
FAQ.q5: Do you offer traditional Ethiopian ceremony decorations?
FAQ.a5: Absolutely. We specialize in Habesha and traditional ceremony styling — stage, entrance, table, and full venue — with respect for cultural details and color preferences.
FAQ.q6: How do I track my order?
FAQ.a6: After checkout you’ll receive an order number. Sign in to your account and open My Orders to see status updates: Pending, Confirmed, Preparing, Ready, Out for Delivery, and Completed.
FAQ.q7: Can I include a gift message?
FAQ.a7: Yes. Add a note at checkout or when building a custom design. Greeting cards and custom message cards are also available as add-ons.
FAQ.q8: What if I need to change or cancel an order?
FAQ.a8: Contact us as soon as possible by phone or WhatsApp. Changes and cancellations depend on how far preparation has progressed; we’ll always try to accommodate you.
